simple.summary: רִיבַי (Rîybay) means Ribai , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 31.

definitions.full: H7380. Ribay רִיבַי proper name, masculine in Benjamin , 2Sam 23:29 ( Πειβα , Εριβα ) = 1 Chronicles 11:81 ( Πεβιε , Πηβαι , Πιβατ , etc.); compare ידִיבי below.
